document.abstract: This year marks the 25th anniversary of Canada's association with the SMPTE. I have been privileged to be a part of an association that has nurtured the very best in scientific technology and mutual cooperation between two countries … the United States and Canada. Those members of the SMPTE who are citizens of North America, with; I similar history and culture, have used the technology of the two countries for the mutual benefit of two allied disciplines - motion pictures and television.
